golden_atomic_brand_references.definition: Golden = best-in-class example of its type; Atomic = a single self-contained reusable unit; Brand Reference = fed back to an image model to generate net-new on-brand assets.
golden_atomic_brand_references.discipline: Generated incrementally with human validation; each stored next to its prompt + alt text; pass references in for reused elements to prevent drift.

graphic_types.suffix: {{Prompt suffix appended verbatim for this type.}}

golden_atomic_brand_templates.definition: Golden = best-in-class and human-validated; Atomic = one self-contained reusable unit; Brand Template = coded HTML/CSS filled with per-instance props and rendered to exact pixels. The coded twin of the GABR.
golden_atomic_brand_templates.rule: Any asset whose numbers or copy must be exact (data slide / stat card, scorecard, before/after table, open-graph card) is a GABT, never a generated GABR — image models garble text and digits.
